_comment: Golden audit cases authored by the extension (architecture review 2026-10-26, Critical 1). Each case lists the rule statuses the extension's engine produces; every engine (extension, app/functions/src/audit/engine.ts) must produce the same. `html` is a full document, `url` the scanned page, `xRobotsTag` the response header when the case needs one. `serverToday` records what the app engine returned when this file was written, so the app knows which cases it must change. See docs/contract/README.md.

cases.name: robots content=none de-indexes
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><meta name="robots" content="none"></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: a second robots tag with noindex de-indexes
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><meta name="robots" content="index, follow"><meta name="robots" content="noindex"></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: X-Robots-Tag: noindex de-indexes a page whose HTML is clean
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: a canonical pointing at another page warns
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/"></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: a self canonical passes
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/blog/post-1"></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: hreflang self-reference matches across a trailing slash
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/blog/"><link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://example.com/blog"><link rel="alternate" hreflang="de" href="https://example.com/de/blog"></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: two <title> elements count as a duplicate
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><title>Another title</title></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: an empty description is a missing description
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><meta name="description" content=""></head><body></body></html>

cases.name: an SVG <title> in the body is not the page title
not an article: article-og is not applicable
cases.html: <html><head><title>A page title that is long enough to pass</title><meta property="og:type" content="website"></head><body></body></html>
